pairs: Tunc Jesus locutus est ad turbas,
Then Jesus spoke to the crowds,
Super cathedram Moysi sederunt scribæ et pharisæi.
“The scribes and the Pharisees have sat down in the chair of Moses.
Omnia ergo quæcumque dixerint vobis, servate,
Therefore, all things whatsoever that they shall say to you,
secundum opera vero eorum nolite facere:
Yet truly, do not choose to act according to their works.
and they impose them on men’s shoulders.
digito autem suo nolunt ea movere.
But they are not willing to move them with even a finger of their own.
Omnia vero opera sua faciunt ut videantur ab hominibus:
they do all their works so that they may be seen by men.
For they enlarge their phylacteries and glorify their hems.
Amant autem primos recubitus in cœnis,
And they love the first places at feasts,
and the first chairs in the synagogues,
and to be called Master by men.
But you must not be called Master.
Et patrem nolite vocare vobis super terram:
And do not choose to call anyone on earth your father.
unus est enim pater vester qui in cælis est.
For One is your Father, who is in heaven.
Neither should you be called teachers.
Qui major est vestrum, erit minister vester.
Whoever is greater among you shall be your minister.
Væ autem vobis scribæ et pharisæi hypocritæ,
So then: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees,
quia clauditis regnum cælorum ante homines!
you hypocrites! For you close the kingdom of heaven before men.
For you yourselves do not enter,
and those who are entering, you would not permit to enter.
Væ vobis scribæ et pharisæi hypocritæ,
Woe to you scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites!
For you consume the houses of widows,
praying long prayers. Because of this,
you shall receive the greater judgment.
For you travel around by sea and by land,
in order to make one convert.
And when he has been converted,
facitis eum filium gehennæ duplo quam vos.
you make him twice the son of Hell that you are yourselves.
‘Whoever will have sworn by the temple,
qui autem juraverit in auro templi,
But whoever will have sworn by the gold of the temple is obligated.’
or the temple that sanctifies the gold?
And you say: ‘Whoever will have sworn by the altar,
quicumque autem juraverit in dono, quod est super illud, debet.
But whoever will have sworn by the gift that is on the altar is obligated.’
How blind you are! For which is greater:
or the altar that sanctifies the gift?
Qui ergo jurat in altari, jurat in eo,
Therefore, whoever swears by the altar,
et in omnibus quæ super illud sunt.
swears by it, and by all that is on it.
And whoever will have sworn by the temple,
et in eo qui habitat in ipso:
and by him who dwells in it.
swears by the throne of God,
et in eo qui sedet super eum.
and by him who sits upon it.
Væ vobis scribæ et pharisæi hypocritæ,
Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites!
qui decimatis mentham, et anethum, et cyminum,
For you collect tithes on mint and dill and cumin,
et reliquistis quæ graviora sunt legis, judicium,
but you have abandoned the weightier things of the law:
These you ought to have done,
Væ vobis scribæ et pharisæi hypocritæ,
Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites!
quia mundatis quod deforis est calicis et paropsidis;
For you clean what is outside the cup and the dish,
intus autem pleni estis rapina et immunditia!
but on the inside you are full of avarice and impurity.
munda prius quod intus est calicis, et paropsidis,
First clean the inside of the cup and the dish,
ut fiat id, quod deforis est, mundum.
and then what is outside becomes clean.
Væ vobis scribæ et pharisæi hypocritæ,
Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites!
For you are like whitewashed sepulchers,
quæ a foris parent hominibus speciosa,
which outwardly appear brilliant to men, yet truly,
intus vero pleni sunt ossibus mortuorum, et omni spurcitia!
inside, they are filled with the bones of the dead and with all filth.
Sic et vos a foris quidem paretis hominibus justi:
So also, you certainly appear to men outwardly to be just.
intus autem pleni estis hypocrisi et iniquitate.
But inwardly you are filled with hypocrisy and iniquity.
who build the sepulchers of the prophets and adorn the monuments of the just.
Si fuissemus in diebus patrum nostrorum,
‘If we had been there in the days of our fathers,
non essemus socii eorum in sanguine prophetarum!
we would not have joined with them in the blood of the prophets.’
And so you are witnesses against yourselves,
quia filii estis eorum, qui prophetas occiderunt.
that you are the sons of those who killed the prophets.
Et vos implete mensuram patrum vestrorum.
Complete, then, the measure of your fathers.
How will you escape from the judgment of Hell?
Ideo ecce ego mitto ad vos prophetas,
For this reason, behold, I send to you prophets and wise men,
et scribas, et ex illis occidetis, et crucifigetis,
And some of these you will put to death and crucify;
et ex eis flagellabitis in synagogis vestris, et persequemini de civitate in civitatem:
and some you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,
ut veniat super vos omnis sanguis justus,
so that upon you may fall all the blood of the just,
which has been shed upon the earth,
a sanguine Abel justi usque ad sanguinem Zachariæ,
from the blood of Abel the just,
even to the blood of Zechariah the son of Barachiah,
quem occidistis inter templum et altare.
whom you killed between the temple and the altar.
venient hæc omnia super generationem istam.
all these things shall fall upon this generation.
quæ occidis prophetas, et lapidas eos, qui ad te missi sunt,
You kill the prophets and stone those who have been sent to you.
How often I have wanted to gather your children together,
quemadmodum gallina congregat pullos suos sub alas, et noluisti?
in the way that a hen gathers her young under her wings. But you were not willing!
Ecce relinquetur vobis domus vestra deserta.
Behold, your house shall be abandoned to you, having been deserted.
you shall not see me again,
Benedictus, qui venit in nomine Domini.
‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.’”
